info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Servicing Card Cases-spec
info.description: The Servicing Card Cases Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information regarding servicing card cases within the banking sector. This endpoint allows financial institutions and their service representatives to efficiently list active card cases, facilitating quicker resolutions and enhanced customer support. Typical consumers include bank employees and external service providers who need to consult or manage card servicing issues. The API streamlines workflows by providing comprehensive data at their fingertips.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch details of a specific card case from the servicing system. Use this to get the current status and information related to the card case.

requestBody.description: The request body for fetching card case servicing operations. This body must contain the necessary parameters as defined in the schema to retrieve the relevant data.

200.description: Request completed successfully and returns the card case details.

ListServicingCardCasesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation for card case servicing.
